profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer @ Cura OS
profile.summary: I am currently a Lead Software Engineer at Cura OS. I hold interests in software engineering, mobile technologies, AI and ML, however I have a passion for coding, learning, and innovating.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.insights: Node.js, Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and +3 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Collaboratively designed and developed micro‐services and APIs using Java and gRPC to add new functionality for the Data and Measurement studio platforms within Terminus
• Discovered, debugged, and resolved numerous bugs across our team‐owned services; as result prevented potential revenue losses for enterprise‐level customers
• Effectively led first migration of team’s services from Convox to Kubernetes (AWS EKS)
• Utilized AWS’s suite of services alongside the development and maintenance of team’s services. S3,SQS,SNS,DynamoDB,RDS,Lambda,EKS,
IAM, Athena, were among some of the frequently used AWS services
• Contributed ideas to the engineering department’s adoption of scrum methodologies
• Helped onboard engineers from all levels on technologies from Terminus’s stack that they hadn’t used previously

*Affected by layoffs November 2022
positions.insights: gRPC, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and +2 skills

positions.title: Specialist, Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Successfully deployed to production sprint stories and projects in different languages, such as Java, Oracle PLSQL, and ColdFusion.
• Implemented back‑end project that consumes transactions from Broker Dealer partners that total over 10000+ financial and investment advi‑
sors.
• Led development of API and microservice for integration of external Fintech product into our web platform.
• Created and maintained functions, procedures, triggers, packages and other aspects of our database in Oracle PLSQL.
• Took the initiative to become part of the Innovation Council in the Nationwide Annuities division, in order to come up with ideas that will
positively impact the business.
• Used programming languages such as Python and R to create machine learning models for different business ideas.
• Ensured high‑quality code using agile methodologies
• Consistently exceeded expectations on yearly and mid-year performance reviews
